facts.business: Niyogin Fintech is a technology-led financial services company serving small businesses, MSMEs, and rural communities across India through a tech-enabled NBFC for credit and iServeU for payments technology and infrastructure, spanning lending, payments, wealth, and software-led financial services.
key_risks: High estimation uncertainty in ECL provisioning for loans
Significant management judgement required in defining credit risk thresholds, PD/LGD estimation, and forward-looking scenarios
Execution risk of composite scheme of arrangement (demerger of NBFC into Niyogin Finserv and amalgamation into iServeU) pending NCLT sanction
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions entered during the year were in ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis. Transactions include KMP remuneration (salary/bonus/sitting fees) and no other payments to subsidiaries or entity with significant influence.
